name: codex-novel
description: Create guided Novel projects, then bootstrap, write, review, and transactionally publish local long-form fiction through the Novel CLI.

interface.longDescription: Codex Novel loads each selected project's boundaries in place, keeps staging inputs contained inside that project, navigates exact historical prose, and surfaces exact publication approval as soon as a Scene review is ready while publishing only after the author approves the digest.
defaultPrompt: Use the Novel creation skills to load the selected project contract in place, keep candidate inputs contained, and surface each ready Scene's exact publication digest before ending the writing turn.
